Master Sommelier & Beverage Director

Matthieu Laurent

Biodynamic Terroir & Living Fermentations

Artisans of Flame & Earth ✦ Portland, Oregon

A Devotion to Terroir & Handcrafted Gastronomy

Born in Burgundy into a family of vignerons, Matthieu spent two decades exploring natural vineyards throughout France, Italy, and Oregon before anchoring our beverage cellar.

Daily Process & Philosophy

Matthieu tastes over 1,200 bottles annually, hand-selecting exclusively unmanipulated cuvées that honor wild indigenous fermentations. He also leads our non-alcoholic distillation program using herbs gathered from our conservatory.

"Wine is bottled sunshine and rain; our mission is to present it with total respect for the hands that tended the vines."

Accolades & Distinctions:
★ Court of Master Sommeliers (DipWSET) ★ Top 40 Under 40 Tastemaker ★ Biodynamic Cellar of the Year
